description: Java class `GameControllerInput` demonstrating handling input events from game controllers, including device enumeration, button presses, joystick motions, and device state management. Implements an activity that visualizes and logs controller input events.

classes.name: GameControllerInput
classes.description: Main activity class for demonstrating game controller input handling and visualization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes input manager, device states, UI components, and sets up the activity layout.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers input device listener and enumerates current input devices.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Ensures game view receives focus when window focus changes.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events from controllers, updates device state and UI.

methods.name: dispatchGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles motion events from joystick controllers, updates device state.

methods.name: getInputDeviceState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates device state for a given device ID.

methods.name: onInputDeviceAdded
methods.description: Logs and updates state when a new input device is added.

classes.name: InputDeviceState
classes.description: Tracks axes, keys, and inputs for an individual input device.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Updates key state and logs when a key is pressed.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Updates key state and logs when a key is released.

methods.name: onJoystickMotion
methods.description: Logs joystick motion and historical values.

methods.name: isGameKey
methods.description: Determines if a key code is relevant for game input.

classes.name: SummaryAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for displaying device, axes, and keys status in a ListView.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Populates visible items with current device state.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Shows a toast with device info when an item is clicked.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Abstract class representing an item in the list adapter.

classes.name: Heading
classes.description: Represents a heading in the list UI.

classes.name: TextColumn
classes.description: Displays a label and content, used for device info, axes, and keys.
